Note 2 (ticket 1):

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Christopher Myers (E012)
Request: write access to Source Code

Access policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Analyst does not own Source Code (Engineer owns it). So max for full-time Analyst = write.
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Security DB says contractor with basic training, so max = read.

There's a conflict: HR note says full-time, recommendation write. Security note says contractor with basic training, recommendation read. Security records govern.

So the maximum is read (contractor with basic training). Requested write is above max, so grant read.

Submit decision: read.
